findings.note: The Covers matchup page shows Over trends (Blues Over 6-0 in their last 6 road games, Rangers Over 8-2 in their last 10 home games) and no expert picks. A Covers user, 'miacity', picked Over 5.5, which is half a goal easier than this bet's line of 6.

The Nov 1 Covers preview says the Rangers had lost three straight with Dylan Garand posting a .838 save percentage, which suggests weak backup goaltending. Tonight's starter and Shesterkin's status were not confirmed.

The CBS Blues page lists the game at MSG with NYR -126 and O/U 6. Other markets cited by Covers sit at 5.5, so the Over 6 here carries push risk at exactly 6 goals and gets less value than the 5.5 line.

ESPN's 2026-27 log shows 18 shots in 12 games, about 1.5 per game. He had 2+ shots in 3 of his last 5 games (0, 2, 2, 3, 0), and his ice time rose to 25:25 on 10/31 at NSH, though he had 0 shots that night. More minutes mean more risk to the Under.

RotoWire notes on CBS show a low shot rate: 80 shots in 70 games in 2025-26, and his shooting was flagged as light. He was a healthy scratch Oct. 15 this year and has been in a third-pair role, but he has also gotten some power-play time.

An Oct. 3, 2026 RotoWire note says he sits behind Hedman and Carlson on the blue line and power play, and that one injury would change that. I found no injury, lineup or analyst-pick reporting dated for tonight's DET@TB game.
RotoWire's Oct 25, 2026 note says Copp has just 1 assist (2 G, 3 PTS) in 11 games this season. He is centering the third line but also getting power-play time, which partly helps the Over.
RotoWire (Oct 16, 2026) calls the 32-year-old a bottom-six veteran who is 'not expected to be a major scorer,' which lowers his assist chances compared with his 2025-26 top-six role.

ESPN's stat page shows him averaging about 19:30 TOI in October with 1 assist, a power-play assist, in 8 games. It also lists a 2026-27 projection of about 10 assists over 82 games. I found no injury news or game-specific preview for the Tampa matchup.

This Nov 1, 2026 update is mixed for the bet: Kreider had 7 points in 14 games and only recently ended a nine-game point drought after being moved from the top line to the middle six, though he still gets power-play time and has points in two straight games.

This confirms Kreider signed a one-year deal with Montreal in September 2026 after scoring 50 points in 75 games for Anaheim; a sidebar headline dated Oct 26, 2026 says Hellebuyck was traded to the Devils, which could weaken Winnipeg's goaltending, but this search did not confirm it.
ESPN reports Kreider, 35, signed a one-year, $2.15M AAV deal with Montreal, where coach Martin St. Louis is a former Rangers teammate, after Anaheim ended his contract to free up cap space.

Old (Nov 24, 2025), not current: Miller missed his second straight game, a home game against St. Louis, while day to day, and had only six assists in 22 games then. That's a weak assist rate and a history of missed time.

Old (Dec 2025): Miller scored the OT winner in a 2-1 win at St. Louis but had no assist. He was playing his usual top-six role and was on pace to finish below a point per game for the first time since 2020-21.
